item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian missiles and drones continue to strike Ukrainian infrastructure, hitting Kyiv power plants and causing widespread outages for 550,000 households, while a wave of missiles overnight killed one person and injured eight in the capital. Sabotage cells inside Russia are targeting Russian infrastructure, including oil facilities in St Petersburg that were hit in an overnight attack. President Trump has signed an executive order waiving a new Russia sanctions package, prompting Zelenskyy to accuse him of rewarding Putin. The war caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

In Gaza, the World Food Programme is ending aid for half a million people because of funding shortfalls, while UNICEF reports 340 children killed despite a ceasefire. The conflict continues to generate high mortality, with 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation
item.description:
Houthi forces have intensified attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking a military camp in Yemen that killed at least 20 soldiers and launching rockets that injured six civilians in southern Saudi Arabia, while Saudi air strikes hit northern Yemen killing nine people. Iran is providing targeting and intelligence support to the Houthis, and Egypt has pledged necessary support to Saudi Arabia against the Houthis. The conflict has also seen a Houthi threat to a Saudi skyscraper workforce, prompting the company to send employees home. A helicopter crash near Najran killed two Saudi officers. The war produced 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Syria: the situation
item.description:
Syrian authorities say a suspect in an Assad-era massacre was abducted from Lebanon while Damascus remains open to dialogue despite security concerns, and the Israeli Defense Forces continue to enforce a southern Syria buffer zone. Israeli incursions into southern provinces, including Quneitra and Daraa, are being condemned as they obstruct reconstruction and threaten stability, prompting protests after an explosion at a martyrs’ cemetery in Aleppo and a separate blast in Damascus during Macron’s visit. The Syrian Kurdish community is reported to prefer Bashar al-Assad over Erdogan, and the SDF repelled an armed group’s attempt to infiltrate Ain Issa. 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

The SSPDF reported neutralizing a SPLA-IO/NAS commander linked to a massacre of 36 people in Khor Gal-tan, while the Upper Nile governor condemned an attack that killed 23 in Ulang County. Political pressure mounts as the president gave Machar a 48‑hour deadline to return and the UN condemned the surge in violence. The multi-donor ResPEct project ended its four-year effort to combat gender-based violence. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:

Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy fighting in Baidoa. Ethiopia announced a withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own conflict escalates, and Somaliland and Puntland were designated as "friendly" in an Israeli security framework. Somalia is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and has agreed to acquire Pakistani JF‑17 fighter jets. The UCDP recorded 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

President Tinubu approved security equipment to protect trains from bandit attacks. An air traffic controller remains captive after being abducted at Sokoto airport for 52 days.
